items.title_original: JOB OPENINGS AND LABOR TURNOVER — SEPTEMBER 2026
items.body_original:
The number of job openings was little changed at 7.5 million in September, the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics reported today. Hires and total separations changed little at 5.4 million and 5.3 million, respectively. Within separations, quits (3.4 million) increased, while layoffs and discharges (1.6 million) were little changed.

The number and rate of job openings were little changed at 7.5 million and 4.5 percent, respectively, in September. Job openings increased in state and local government, excluding education (+104,000).

In September, the number of total separations was little changed at 5.3 million, while the rate was unchanged at 3.3 percent. Total separations increased in accommodation and food services (+195,000).

The number of quits increased to 3.4 million, while the rate was little changed at 2.1 percent in September. Quits increased in accommodation and food services (+197,000) but decreased in arts, entertainment, and recreation (-19,000). Over the year, total nonfarm quits increased by 375,000.
items.body_ko_ai:
미국 노동통계국은 9월 구인 건수가 750만 건으로 큰 변화가 없었다고 밝혔다. 채용은 540만 건, 총 이직은 530만 건으로 큰 변화가 없었다. 이직 가운데 자발적 퇴사(340만 건)는 늘었고 해고(160만 건)는 큰 변화가 없었다.

9월 구인 건수와 구인율은 각각 750만 건, 4.5%로 큰 변화가 없었다. 구인은 교육을 제외한 주·지방정부에서 10만4천 건 늘었다.

9월 총 이직은 530만 건으로 큰 변화가 없었고 이직률은 3.3%로 같았다. 총 이직은 숙박·음식서비스업에서 19만5천 건 늘었다.

9월 자발적 퇴사는 340만 건으로 늘었고 퇴사율은 2.1%로 큰 변화가 없었다. 퇴사는 숙박·음식서비스업에서 19만7천 건 늘었고 예술·오락·여가업에서는 1만9천 건 줄었다. 1년 사이 전체 퇴사는 37만5천 건 늘었다.

items.title_original: Unemployment rates lower in 226 metro areas from September 2025 to September 2026
items.body_original:
Unemployment rates lower in 226 metro areas from September 2025 to September 2026

Unemployment rates were lower in September 2026 than a year earlier in 226 of the 387 metropolitan areas, higher in 138 areas, and unchanged in 23 areas. A total of 48 areas had jobless rates of less than 3.0 percent, and 5 areas had rates of at least 8.0 percent.
items.body_ko_ai: 2026년 9월 미국 도시권(389곳)의 실업률은 1년 전보다 226곳에서 낮았고 138곳에서 높았으며 23곳은 변동이 없었다. 실업률이 3% 미만인 도시권은 48곳, 8% 이상인 곳은 5곳이었다.
